adversity.event: Groin discomfort first reported around the Levante game (Levante 2-3 Barcelona; Yamal's cross forced the stoppage-time own-goal winner).
adversity.confidence: low-medium - one summary; another says the issue arose on Spain duty in September. Sources conflict.

adversity.event: First layoff (~19 days). Missed the UCL opener v Newcastle (18 Sep) and LaLiga games v Valencia, Getafe, Oviedo (one summary says 5 games, another 4).
Returns as a substitute v Real Sociedad (2-1 comeback win); sets up Lewandowski's winner; own goal ruled out for offside.

Groin problem flares again in the UCL home defeat to PSG (1-2). Diagnosed as pubalgia (chronic groin injury / soft-tissue tear). Barca announce 2-3 weeks out; Flick says it could be longer. Barca report invasive radiofrequency treatment for pubic-area discomfort (7-10 days expected). Spain/Barca dispute over his minutes and treatment follows.
adversity.confidence: medium-high on pubalgia and recurrence; dates of the radiofrequency treatment not pinned down

adversity.event: Back v Girona (assist for Pedri 13', Barca win 2-1 on Araujo 90+3').

El Clasico at the Bernabeu, lost 1-2: Yamal plays 90 min, whistled every touch, no shots on target, Goal rating 3/10; Barca assistant Marcus Sorg says he was 'affected' by the atmosphere. Bounces back with a 6' goal v Elche on 2 Nov.

Withdrawn from Spain's November camp for an 'invasive procedure' / more groin treatment; reports of Barca targeting a return for the Chelsea game; an outside doctor (not his treating team) claimed he was playing at '50%'. He plays at Chelsea on 25 Nov (Barca lose 0-3, Araujo sent off, Yamal subbed 80'), then returns to form v Alaves (29 Nov).
Not in the starting XI for the Supercopa semi-final v Athletic (5-0); reason not found (rest vs minor issue unconfirmed). Played the final on 11 Jan.
Copa del Rey semi-final v Atletico: 0-4 away, then 3-0 home (Yamal assist for Bernal) - out 3-4 on aggregate.
UCL QF v Atletico: 0-2 home defeat (10-man Barca, Cubarsi red), then 2-1 away win with Yamal's 4' goal - out 2-3 on aggregate.

Scores a 40' penalty v Celta (1-0) then goes down clutching his left hamstring (biceps femoris); replaced 45+9' by Roony Bardghji. Barca confirm he is out for the rest of the season but expected to be available for the World Cup. ESPN sources initially feared a tear.
Misses the title-clinching Clasico v Real Madrid (2-0) through injury. Also missed the remaining league fixtures (matchdays 34-38, derived).
adversity.confidence: high (absence); medium (count of games missed is derived)

adversity.event: Recovers and, per one summary, contributes to Spain's World Cup win (final v Argentina in July). Outside the club-season brief - the national-team scout should verify.

moments.what_happens: First professional hat-trick. Goal 1 (28'): Fermin Lopez robs Pape Gueye and slips the ball down the right; Yamal finishes low inside the left post. Goal 2: solo goal - cuts in from the right wing, beats a defender and curls a shot high into the far corner (foot not stated in the source; right-wing cut-in strongly suggests left foot, confirm on footage). Goal 3 (69'): finishes another counter-attack. Lewandowski taps in a fourth in added time from Koundé's low cross.
moments.best_seconds: Goal 2: right-wing cut-inside -> defender beaten -> curler dips into far top corner -> net ripple (about 3s). Back-up: goal 1 low finish inside the post at 28'.
moments.case_value: Headline performance of his season: first career hat-trick, youngest player of the 21st century to score a LaLiga hat-trick (18y 230d); kept Barca four points clear of Real Madrid in the title race.
